protocol.planned_windows: All starts range(0, frames-round(10*fps)+1, round(fps)); center=(start+window/2)/fps. Old/new grids must match exactly within 1e-8 s; no fitted offset.
protocol.output_definition: accepted Boolean AND finite prediction in the evaluated estimator column
protocol.reference_eligibility: Finite positive calculable reference HR; UBFC additionally requires time coverage. Raw physiological reference quality has NOT been independently audited.
protocol.C_out: 100 * Noutput / Nplanned (all planned windows, including no-reference cases)
protocol.C_ref: 100 * Nvalid / Nref; undefined without reference-eligible windows
protocol.R5: 100 * count(abs(prediction-reference)<=5) / Nref; zero if Nref>0 but no correct output, undefined if Nref=0
protocol.P10_R10: Analogous definitions at 10 bpm; boundary inclusive
protocol.LoA: Descriptive Bias +/-1.96 * sample SD(ddof=1); undefined at N<2. Not confidence intervals, not population limits established by independent subjects.
protocol.common_windows: Report all 9 HR branch output intersection and predetermined pair intersections, then restrict to reference-eligible. Coverage/R5 remain in original-denominator metrics.csv; not redefined on selected common windows.
protocol.delta_sign: after minus before; lower error is favorable, higher coverage/R5/SNR is favorable. Paired SNR median is median of per-window differences, not difference of medians.
protocol.delta_SNR_sign_counts: Positive/negative/tie proportions use +/-1e-9 dB numerical tolerance so machine-precision differences are not called gains. Raw >0 proportion is retained separately. This tolerance does not define meaningful biological improvement.
protocol.waveform_SNR: 10*log10(sum(PSD at reference H1 +/-0.1Hz)/sum(other PSD in 0.7-3.5Hz)); only H1 counted. Not an absolute calibrated artifact-energy measurement.
protocol.waveform_input: Saved base column; no extra filtering. fps=1/median(diff(saved time_s)); start=round(center*fps-n/2). Require accepted HR window plus complete finite waveform segment and calculable reference.
protocol.waveform_common: All 5 waveform finite reference-SNR intersection plus predetermined pair intersections. Own includes accepted finite segments only; no reference means no reference-SNR.
protocol.waveform_generation: Fusion waveform_generated_count and waveform_generated_planned_pct use the explicit flag, distinct from HR acceptance and finite overlap coverage. A non-generated window may still contain a finite base waveform contributed by neighbors. generated_only is an additional provenance subset, not a replacement denominator or morphology validation.
protocol.waveform_r: Not computed: no independently validated synchronized waveform morphology ground truth. Narrow 0.7-3.5 Hz output cannot establish dicrotic-notch recovery.
protocol.branch_timing: POS/CHROM ridge is offline DP in both versions. Fusion ridge selection is forward-only, but waveforms use offline zero-phase filtering and overlap fusion; full pipeline is not real-time.
protocol.selection: No parameter fitting, reference-guided peak choice, temporal-offset fitting or accuracy scoring for unreferenced video.

limitations: Overlapping 10 s windows (~1 s step) are dependent; N is a window count, not independent sample size or duration. No t-test, significance claim or population confidence interval is produced.
UBFC is a single human video with device-HR reference. Do not pool synthetic72 with human accuracy or infer general motion robustness from this small collection.
user0904, user0907 and kaggle_full have no synchronized HR reference: output coverage, continuity or plausible BPM cannot establish accuracy.
Reference-frequency H1 SNR is spectral concentration relative to the provided reference. It does not establish waveform morphology, remove all artifacts, or measure medical signal quality.
C_out and C_ref are ratios of overlapping planned windows. Full-video pixel/ROI coverage and finite waveform samples are different quantities.
A comparison on each method's accepted windows may favor stricter rejection. Consult pair-common error/SNR and original-denominator C/R5 together.

reference.aggregation: Merge duplicate timestamps by mean; mean finite positive device HR in [center-5, center+5); require full reference time coverage and >1 selected sample.
reference.warning: Not direct ECG. Computational eligibility is not an independent physiological-quality review.

reference.aggregation: Known 1.2 Hz color modulation; engineering self-test, not human HR accuracy.

pre_validation_protocol.note: Defaults frozen after synthetic logic tests; no real-reference parameter search.
